status: exact projected identities and conditional obstructions; native extraction and dynamics not evaluated

exact_projected_equation.definition: r=T(t) u, chi=i r; T real-linear includes alignment, extraction and field/carrier identification
exact_projected_equation.factorization_scope: fixed instantaneous linear probe/background operator; field-dependent nonlinear lifts need their own fibre-consistency test
exact_projected_equation.decomposition: u=R r+z, T R=I, T z=0; r_dot=K r+q, K=(T_dot+T G_real)R, q=(T_dot+T G_real)z
exact_projected_equation.autonomy_iff: (T_dot+T G_real) ker T=0 for all allowed lifts, or the corresponding restricted-carrier condition

fixed_frame_Hermitian_case.split: H=S+iB, S real symmetric, B real skew; f=x+i r
fixed_frame_Hermitian_case.equations: x_dot=B x+S r; r_dot=B r-S x
fixed_frame_Hermitian_case.autonomy_for_all_hidden_inputs_iff: S=0, equivalently J H J^(-1)=-H for J=conjugation
fixed_frame_Hermitian_case.memory_equation_constant_operators: r_dot=B r-S exp(Bt)x0-integral_0^t S exp(B(t-s)) S r(s) ds

moving_frame_and_damping.moving_local_H: V* H V-i V* V_dot, with J=V K_complex V*
moving_frame_and_damping.positive_damping_specialization: G=-iH-D; full odd autonomy requires Re H=0 and Im D=0; then K=Im H-Re D
moving_frame_and_damping.native_temporal_compensator_piece: -kappa n_0 H_C is only one piece, not the complete native HC generator
moving_frame_and_damping.complete_native_compensator_contribution: G_HC=-(Gamma^0)^(-1)[kappa Gamma^mu n_mu+i gamma I] H_C

linear_three_chamber_obstruction.scope: a fixed state-independent autonomous real 2x2 generator, all three chambers and all nonzero residuals
linear_three_chamber_obstruction.angular_law: theta_dot=2[omega+c cos(theta)+d sin(theta)], omega=(K21-K12)/2, c=(K21+K12)/2, d=(K22-K11)/2
linear_three_chamber_obstruction.boundary_guards: v(left_j)>=0 and v(right_j)<=0 for every j=0,1,2
linear_three_chamber_obstruction.conclusion: K=a I: amplitude scaling only; if norm preserving, K=0
linear_three_chamber_obstruction.proof: three disjoint admitted intervals require at least three zeros; a nonzero first-harmonic function has at most two

native_invariance_and_matching_targets.exact_test: 6 det(r,(T_dot+T G_real)u)/(r.r) has inward signs at Phi=+/-pi/4 for every admitted lift u
native_invariance_and_matching_targets.conditional_normalized_coisometric_bound: if ||u||=1 and TT*=I, ||q||/||r||<=||hidden_coupling||sqrt(1-||r||^2)/||r||; no uniform bound near zero residual
native_invariance_and_matching_targets.robust_full_chamber_guards: unforced theta velocity at left >=2epsilon and at right <=-2epsilon
native_invariance_and_matching_targets.gradient_matching_if_norm_constant: (T_dot+T G_real)u=-(m/6) F'(Phi) A r; A=[[0,-1],[1,0]]; this is a target not a derived identity
